# Crowd Circuit artwork and sound

The arena, runner circles, HUD and checkpoint tone are original procedural work for Shop Trial. There are no external models, textures, fonts or audio recordings. Homie's bundled palette and coin-dash movement/framework are credited on the landing page and in CODEX.md.

`hero/wide.jpg` (1280 × 720) and `hero/tall.jpg` (720 × 1280) are screenshots of this game's own 150-simulated-player local trial, taken after the measured interval. They show the actual room and contain no third-party artwork. Source receipts: `reports/crowd-circuit/local-150-repeat/`.
